allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Housing & Urban Development Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Bond Allotment Committee meeting held Today i.e.  July 17, 2025 for raising of Debentures as Unsecured, Taxable, Redeemable, Non-Convertible, Non- Cumulative NCDs of face value of Rs. 1,00,000 each (Series-D 2025) aggregating up to Rs.3000.00 Crore on PrivatePlacement basis.
